title: abicheck BundleFacts archive manifest (G40)
description: Schema for `manifest.json` inside the G40 zip archive form of BundleFacts (`dump RELEASE --bundle-facts-out FILE.zip`). The archive stores each distinct member snapshot, the instantiation manifest and the public surface once, as content-addressed blobs; this manifest maps library names to those blob hashes and carries the container's remaining fields inline. Two versions are recorded: `schema_version` is the archive container's own layout version, `bundle_facts_schema_version` is the BundleFacts shape it encodes (see bundle_facts.schema.json; 2 for a clean release, 3 with degraded members, 4 with a public surface, 5 with a member blob stored as its sectioned snapshot document). Both are required.

library_blobs.description: Library name to the content hash of its AbiSnapshot blob. Several names may share one blob.

manifest_blob.description: Content hash of the instantiation-manifest blob, or null when the release supplied none.

public_surface_blob.description: Content hash of the release's public-surface blob (bundle_facts_schema_version 4). Omitted, not null, when there is none.
